Method of Attack: Process Doppelgänging is a fileless code injection technique that utilizes NTFS transactions to modify an executable in memory without committing changes to disk, allowing malicious code to run in the context of a legitimate process while bypassing most modern antivirus and forensic tools.
Attack Vector: Fileless attack using NTFS transactions and undocumented Windows process loading mechanisms to inject code without leaving traces on disk
Indicators of Compromise: No malicious code saved to disk; invisible to major security products including Kaspersky, Bitdefender, ESET, Symantec, McAfee, Windows Defender, AVG, Avast, Qihoo 360, Panda, and undetectable by forensic tools like Volatility
